blocks.title: How to
items: Open the AI chat you use (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot…).
Upload **this file**, plus your worksheet, slides or notes if you have them.
Say what you want, e.g. *"Make a 45-minute Brightpage lesson for Year 8 on the water cycle, with a quiz and one photo task."*
Download the file the AI makes and open it in your browser.
Check it, click **⚙ Settings** to add your name, email and Google Drive link, then click **Send out to students**.

blocks.text: The instructions for the AI are already inside this file. You don't need to explain Brightpage to it.
